title: Party of six (R(3,3) ≤ 6)
plain: Among any six people, some three all know each other or some three are all strangers.
math: Every simple graph on 6 vertices contains a triangle or an independent set of size 3.
review_note: Submission test. Estimated proof length about 64 lines; using Mathlib lemmas is allowed. Test problems do not count toward the leaderboards.
